entries.source: Time and space collapse in upon this erratically-moving time elemental.
entries.target: 时空在这只行动飘忽不定的时间元素周围不断塌陷。

entries.source: Stealthy tricksters that leave a wake of deadfalls and other hazards.  They really just make a mess of things.
entries.target: 善于潜行的诡计高手，所过之处遍布落石陷阱和其他危险机关。他们真的只会把一切弄得一团糟。

entries.source: Layers of rotting skin are peeling off of this rat. One of the eye sockets appears empty.
entries.target: 一层层腐烂的皮肤正从这只老鼠身上剥落，它的一只眼窝似乎是空的。

entries.source: An eerie haze surrounds this translucent rat.
entries.target: 诡异的薄雾环绕着这只半透明的老鼠。

entries.source: The Rat Lich's true power has been unveiled! Swirling with arcane energy, it stalks towards you uttering warsqueaks at its minions!
entries.target: 鼠巫妖的真正力量展现出来了！它周身环绕着奥术能量，一边向仆从发出战斗吱叫，一边朝你逼近！

entries.source: These ancient cursed beings often take the form of a bat and attack their prey.
entries.target: 这些被诅咒的古代生物经常以蝙蝠的形式攻击猎物。

entries.source: This vampire has only just begun its new life. It has not yet fathomed its newfound power, yet it still has a thirst for blood.
entries.target: 这只吸血鬼刚开始它的新生活，还不能熟练运用它的新能力，但是它同样渴望鲜血。

entries.source: It is a humanoid with an aura of power. You notice a sharp set of front teeth.
entries.target: 这是一个散发着力量气场的类人生物，你注意到它长着一副锋利的门牙。

entries.source: It is a humanoid form dressed in robes. Power emanates from its chilling frame.
entries.target: 这是一个穿着长袍的人形身影。力量从它冰冷的身躯中散发出来。

entries.source:
A terrible robed undead figure, this creature has existed in its unlife for many centuries by stealing the life of others.
It can summon the very shades of its victims from beyond the grave to come enslaved to its aid.
entries.target:
这个身披长袍的可怕不死生物，靠窃取他人的生命在亡者之身中存在了数百年。
它能从坟墓彼端召唤受害者的阴影，使其臣服前来协助自己。

entries.source: A foul wind chills your bones as this ghastly figure approaches.
entries.target: 当这只可怕的生物靠近时，你感到脊背一阵发凉。

entries.source: A corrosive venom drake hatchling; not too powerful by itself, but it usually comes with its brothers and sisters.
entries.target: 一只腐蚀性的毒龙幼仔。它独自行动时并不强大，但通常有兄弟姐妹相伴。

entries.source: A mature corrosive venom drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
entries.target: 一条成年毒龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

entries.source: An old and powerful corrosive venom drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
entries.target: 一条年长且强大的毒龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

entries.source: %s exudes a corrupted gas as it dies.
It is a ghostly apparition with a humanoid form.
entries.target: 它是一个有着人形的幽灵幻影。

entries.source: It is a ghostly form with eyes that haunt you.
entries.target: 它呈幽灵形态，眼睛一直盯着你。

entries.source: It is a ghostly nightmare of an entity.
Your life force is torn from your body as this powerful unearthly being approaches.
entries.target: 当这只强大的不死生物靠近时，你感觉生命能量被不断地撕扯出身体。

entries.source: A monstrous, coiled wyrm, patient and hateful. Its hide, studded with spikes and crests and blades, turns aside steel and sorcery with equal ease.
entries.target: 一条骇人的盘曲巨龙，耐心而怀恨。它的表皮上布满棘刺、脊冠与利刃，无论钢铁还是法术都被它同样轻易地卸开。

entries.source: A shifting, writhing, snake-like dragon, blinking in and out of existence, just waiting for you to turn your back.
entries.target: 一只不断扭动变幻、忽隐忽现的蛇状巨龙，只等你一转身露出破绽。

entries.source: This bizarre creature has glaring eyes and large mandibles capable of slicing through rock.
entries.target: 这只怪异的生物长着一双怒睁的眼睛和几只能咬穿岩石的巨大口器。

entries.source: A huge creature of the element Earth. Able to merge with its element, it has four huge arms protruding from its enormous torso.
entries.target: 一只巨大的土元素。它有四只巨大的手臂，并且可以融合泥土。

entries.source: It is a tougher relative of the Xorn. Its hide glitters with metal ores.
entries.target: 它是索尔石怪更难对付的近亲，表皮闪烁着金属矿石的光泽。

entries.source: Fragmented essence... maybe it'd be best if it stayed fragmented.
entries.target: 精华碎片……如果它仍然呈碎裂状态就好了。

entries.source: #AQUAMARINE#%s absorbs the energy of the destroyed fragment!
entries.target: #AQUAMARINE#%s 吸收了被摧毁的碎片的能量！

entries.source: #AQUAMARINE#%s is infused with all the energies of the fragments. The real Harkor'Zun is reconstituted!
entries.target: #AQUAMARINE#%s吸收了所有碎片的能量，真正的哈卡祖重生了！

entries.source: A gigantic demon composed of elemental Earth, resembling a twisted Xaren but much, much larger.  It doesn't seem pleased with your presence.
entries.target: 一个由土元素构成的巨大恶魔，它长得像一只扭曲的钻石索尔石怪，但大得多得多。似乎你的到来使它很不高兴。

entries.source: Yaeches are an aquatic subspecies of yeeks. They share the same psionic powers, but they refuse to take part in the Way.
entries.target: 夺魂魔是夺心魔的一支水栖亚种。他们拥有同样的灵能，但夺魂魔拒绝加入维网。
